messages.content:
You are AutoSkill's Document Skill Compiler.
Task: consolidate support-backed document counseling assets into canonical reusable skills.
Output ONLY strict JSON parseable by json.loads.
Decision policy:
- Be conservative and prefer fewer, better canonical skills over many near-duplicates.
- Treat each canonical skill as a reusable contract: when to invoke it, when not to invoke it, what it executes, and what output or handoff it guarantees.
- Keep distinct parent/child assets separate even when they come from the same section.
Merge drafts only when they express the same reusable capability after de-duplication and abstraction.
Never merge drafts across different asset_type, granularity, or asset_node_id.
Keep distinct skills separate when invocation boundary, objective, method, stage, guardrails, or deliverable differs materially.
Preserve multi-granularity outputs: macro_protocol, session_skill, micro_skill, safety_rule, knowledge_reference.
Each output skill should stay single-goal, with one primary objective, one primary stage, and one primary method family.
Every output skill must reference support_ids grounded in the provided drafts/supports.
support_ids must be chosen only from the provided supports.
source_draft_ids must be chosen only from the provided drafts.
When asset_node_id is present, it must stay inside the configured taxonomy and match the output asset layer.
Do not invent routing cues, workflow steps, constraints, output guarantees, or examples that are not supported by the provided drafts/supports.
Return JSON as {"skills": [...]}.
Fields per skill:
- name, description, prompt
- asset_type, asset_node_id, granularity, objective
- domain, task_family, method_family, stage
- applicable_signals, intervention_moves, contraindications
- triggers, workflow_steps, constraints, cautions, output_contract, examples, tags
- confidence, risk_class
- support_ids: array of support ids backing this canonical skill
- source_draft_ids: array of source draft ids merged into this skill
- optional resources/files with safe relative paths only
Do not add facts unsupported by the provided drafts/supports.

{"drafts": [{"draft_id": "aa175b2e-9129-544c-886b-b5de1355700f", "doc_id": "f7a76d82-16fa-5d4e-9e08-dcfb60e9f311", "name": "Feed 存储 URI 参数化配置", "description": "使用 %(name)s、%(time)s 等占位符及 spider 参数构造 Feed 存储 URI，实现按爬虫或时间分目录存储到 FTP/S3 等后端。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "granularity": "micro", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_path": "family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill/micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "visible_role": "leaf", "objective": "生成带动态占位符的 Feed 存储 URI，实现按爬虫/时间分目录归档", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export", "method_family": "uri_templating", "stage": "storage_config", "applicable_signals": ["需要按爬虫或时间分目录存储导出文件", "需要将 spider 参数注入存储路径"], "contraindications": ["目标存储后端不支持 URI 模板占位符", "仅需单文件固定路径输出"], "intervention_moves": ["确定存储后端与基础路径", "选择归档维度占位符（%(name)s、%(time)s）", "将占位符嵌入路径形成 URI 模板", "将 spider 参数作为属性并以占位符引用"], "workflow_steps": ["确认存储后端（FTP/S3 等）与基础路径", "选择归档维度：按爬虫用 %(name)s，按时间用 %(time)s", "组合占位符构造完整 URI 模板", "如需自定义维度，将 spider 参数作为属性并在 URI 中引用其名称", "输出 URI 模板并说明占位符含义"], "triggers": ["需要按爬虫或时间分目录存储导出文件", "需要将 spider 参数注入存储路径"], "constraints": ["占位符名称须与 spider 属性名一致", "URI 模板须符合目标存储后端的 URI 格式"], "cautions": ["凭据直接写入 URI 时注意避免泄露", "确认后端支持所用占位符后再部署"], "output_contract": ["可用的参数化存储 URI 模板，并附各占位符含义说明"], "examples": [{"input": "按爬虫分目录存储到 FTP", "output": "ftp://user:password@ftp.example.com/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json", "notes": "使用 %(name)s 与 %(time)s 实现按爬虫与时间分目录"}, {"input": "按爬虫分目录存储到 S3", "output": "s3://mybucket/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json", "notes": "S3 后端同样支持 URI 模板占位符"}], "risk_class": "low", "confidence": 0.7, "support_ids": ["dbf595a1-246c-5757-b61d-31d84cd8f1cc"], "metadata": {"prompt": "根据目标存储后端与归档维度，构造带动态占位符的 Feed 存储 URI 模板。

执行要点：
1. 确认存储后端（如 FTP、S3）与基础路径。
2. 选择归档维度：按爬虫使用 %(name)s，按时间使用 %(time)s，可组合使用。
3. 将占位符嵌入路径，形成完整 URI 模板，例如 ftp://user:password@host/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json 或 s3://bucket/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json。
4. 若需注入自定义维度，可将 spider 参数作为 spider 属性，并在 URI 中以其名称作为占位符引用。
5. 输出最终 URI 模板，并说明各占位符含义。", "tags": ["scrapy", "feed_export", "uri_templating", "storage_config"], "files": {}, "resources": {}, "source_sections": ["Feed exports"], "extraction_unit": "window", "domain_type": "scrapy", "taxonomy_id": "scrapy", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_path": "family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill/micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "visible_role": "leaf", "candidate_slot": 1, "window_id": "42485160-22f8-5d73-821f-b9b4770378f1", "window_strategy": "strict", "anchor_hits": [], "paragraph_start": 19, "paragraph_end": 21, "heading_path": ["Feed exports"], "parent_heading": "", "sibling_headings": ["input001\feed-exports.md"], "subsection_headings": ["Serialization formats", "JSON", "JSON lines", "CSV", "XML", "Pickle", "Marshal", "Storages", "Storage URI parameters", "Local filesystem", "FTP", "S3", "Google Cloud Storage (GCS)", "Standard output", "Delayed file delivery", "Item filtering", "ItemFilter", "Post-Processing", "Built-in Plugins", "Custom Plugins", "Settings", "FEEDS", "FEED_EXPORT_ENCODING", "FEED_EXPORT_FIELDS", "FEED_EXPORT_INDENT", "FEED_STORE_EMPTY", "FEED_STORAGES", "FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE", "FEED_STORAGE_S3_ACL", "FEED_STORAGES_BASE", "FEED_EXPORTERS", "FEED_EXPORTERS_BASE", "FEED_EXPORT_BATCH_ITEM_COUNT", "FEED_URI_PARAMS"], "context_snippets": [], "heading_number": "", "heading_kind": "outline_llm", "section_summary": "One of the most frequently required features when implementing scrapers is"}}], "supports": [{"support_id": "dbf595a1-246c-5757-b61d-31d84cd8f1cc", "doc_id": "f7a76d82-16fa-5d4e-9e08-dcfb60e9f311", "section": "Feed exports", "excerpt": "Here are some examples to illustrate:

- Store in FTP using one directory per spider:
  - `ftp://user:password@ftp.example.com/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json`
- Store in S3 using one directory per spider:
  - `s3://mybucket/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json`

[Spider arguments](spiders.html#spiderargs) become spider attributes, hence
they can also be used as storage URI parameters.", "relation_type": "support", "confidence": 0.7}], "target_state": "active"}
